objective: Audit every DCAI and AIIO question, match A+ learning depth and functionality, add username/password accounts with isolated progress/mistakes/favourites and Cloudflare registration verification, then publish the tested complete update to GitHub and the existing CentOS server.
requirements: Question-specific Chinese and English explanation for every option, including each incorrect distractor
Faithful Chinese translations of stems and options alongside the original English
Answer verification against primary technical evidence; preserve original answers and document corrections or wording caveats
Question clues, reasoning steps, key facts, bilingual terminology, memory cues, and confusion warnings
Topic modules, module-filtered learning and practice, knowledge maps, search and related-question review links for both banks
Correct explanations in learning, practice feedback, mistake review and exam results, without showing answers before submission
Retain multi-select grading, question images, illustrated matching review, favourites, favourite sync, per-bank progress, jump controls and session restoration
Meaningful content completeness, answer-consistency, reference-integrity and cross-view tests covering every question
Browser QA of both banks including module practice, multi-select, mistake review, exam results, maps and responsive layout
Push exact tested source to GitHub; deploy the same release; verify HTTPS and Cloudflare protection remain functional
Username/password registration and login with server-enforced Cloudflare Turnstile validation
Per-account server persistence for progress, mistakes, favourites and active learning/exam sessions; prevent cross-account data access and stale-device overwrites
Keep guest records separate; provide explicit backup/import migration; test login/logout, persistence, isolation, failed CAPTCHA and production deployment
initialFindings: 172 scored questions have generic PDF-selected/not-selected option explanations, not actual individual bilingual reasons
AIIO has only one source topic and therefore no useful topic filters
CCNP has a matching-question page but no A+-style knowledge map; AIIO has no knowledge-map entry
Existing PDF-derived explanations include claims and answer corrections that need independent verification
Core 2-specific review helpers can produce generic or unrelated advice for AI questions unless AI-specific guides are added
publicationGate: Do not deploy partial annotations as though all questions were verified. coverage.json must have zero pending IDs, followed by semantic review and full validation.
